answer: Per-identity prompts: each account gets its own random required words from a seed tied to its address, and every answer must be original. One operator can't write a single essay and paste it across a thousand fakes; every identity needs fresh work from its own quill. Reuse sinks the farm to its nadir, since near-duplicates are caught and paid nothing. Cost grows linearly with fake count, so a sybil army is as costly as an honest forest of cedar, one tree at a time.
